name: Adachi Chii
source:
[b]An Estranged Childhood Friend Living Next Door[/b]

Grade: Second-year/external student, women's basketball club​ member

[url=/c128223]Kanata[/url]'s neighbor and childhood friend. Due to puberty, there were times when they felt somewhat conscious of each other, so for a while, they became estranged. She sees Kanata as a proactive fool in everything and does not want him to talk to her too much in public. Even though she is mixed in when talking about love, she does not know about love herself, and her naivety tends to confuse the surroundings. When she is absorbed in something, she becomes lively like a child. She loves basketball, and she is expected to be the next ace of the team.

"I told you not to talk to me at school."

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1232470]Getchu[/url]]
